info.syllabusName: Quy hoạch và Quản lý dự án hạ tầng giao thông (Transportation Infrastructure Planning and Management)
info.description: This is an introductory course on planning for and management of transportation and other infrastructures that will support the effective delivery of functions and services in cities with the end goal of realising a more sustainable and inclusive development. The foundational knowledge on transportation covers basic concepts on transport and infrastructure, particularly the interaction between transport and other infrastructures with land use as well as with the overall urban context, integrated transportation planning process, transport data and modelling, transport economics, travel behaviour and travel demand management, public transport planning, active transportation such as walking and cycling, travel behaviour and financing infrastructure. The urban infrastructure component covers water supply and sewerage, water sensitive urban design, solid waste management and social infrastructure planning.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Identify the interaction between transportation and other infrastructure with land use and the wider urban context, including their contribution towards the development of an inclusive, liveable and sustainable city
Explain concepts, principles, policies and practices in urban transport and infrastructure planning
Classify individual mobility and accessibility needs, transport mode options, and travel behavior preferences
Apply concepts and principles in transport and/or infrastructure planning to a team-based project
Evaluate challenges, options and solutions in transport and infrastructure
Develop the ability to be able to reflect on transport and infrastructure planning practice
